const siteUrl = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://h1bsalary.info';

const tweets = [
  `I built a free salary database using 2 million government records that most people don't know exist.

H1B visa disclosures are 100% public. They contain exact salaries for real jobs at real companies.

Here's what I found 🧵`,

  `Google pays a median of $195,000 for Software Engineers based on 12,847 real applications.

Amazon: $187,000
Microsoft: $175,000
Meta: $204,000

These aren't estimates. These are government records.`,

  `The data goes down to specific cities too.

SWE in San Francisco: $210,000 median
SWE in Seattle: $185,000 median
SWE in Austin: $162,000 median

Same company, very different pay.`,

  `I built a free tool to search any company + role combination.

2 million records. No paywall. No signup.
Updated weekly from the DOL database.

${siteUrl}

RT if useful 🙏`
];

return tweets.map((text, i) => ({ json: { text, index: i } }));
